entries.desc: On a clean repo, story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK with a succeeding bootstrap advances phase to INIT_CHECK and creates the worktree (unchanged success behavior)

evidence.note: assertDevStartRecoversStuckInitCheckStory drives the successful bootstrap path: dev_start creates the worktree on disk and prints a Path: line, exercising the same dev_start success that the clean INIT->INIT_CHECK happy advance now depends on (phase persisted only after this success).

entries.desc: When dev_start bootstrap throws, story_get still shows the prior phase (INIT), not INIT_CHECK; output reports failure not advancement

evidence.note: assertFailedBootstrapLeavesPhaseAtInit: with an injected (unfrozen) bootstrap failure, story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK exits non-zero, output reports abort not advancement, and story_get detail still shows phase=INIT (no partial advance), no worktree created.

entries.desc: A victim already at INIT_CHECK with no worktree re-runs story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK: does not throw INIT_CHECK->INIT_CHECK, re-runs dev_start, no double-advance

evidence.note: assertDevStartRecoversStuckInitCheckStory seeds a story already persisted at INIT_CHECK with no worktree (the legacy victim) and re-bootstraps via dev_start without an INIT_CHECK->INIT_CHECK transition error and without double-advancing; idempotent re-run asserted too.

entries.desc: lattice dev_start {storyId} on a story stuck in INIT_CHECK with no worktree on disk recreates the worktree and prints its path

evidence.note: assertDevStartRecoversStuckInitCheckStory: lattice dev_start on a story stuck in INIT_CHECK with no worktree recreates the worktree (existsSync true) and prints its Path: line.

entries.desc: lattice dev_start is idempotent: running it when the worktree already exists returns the existing path without error

evidence.note: Same test second-runs dev_start: idempotent, exits 0, reports the existing worktree (already exists/Path), worktree still present.

entries.desc: lattice dev_start is refused in REVIEW/TEST/DONE phases and refused for an INIT story that has not passed the scope-anti-expansion freeze gate

evidence.note: assertDevStartRefusedInWrongPhases: dev_start refused (non-zero) for DONE and REVIEW stories (handler allowedPhases gate) and for an unfrozen INIT story (scope-anti-expansion freeze gate), citing the freeze gate; unfrozen story creates no worktree.

entries.desc: New smoke test runs green under lattice validate, asserting bootstrap-failure leaves phase unchanged and the recovery path re-bootstraps a stuck story

evidence.note: The new smoke runs green (exit 0, prints init-check atomicity smoke passed) and is registered as npm test:init-check-atomicity-smoke; it asserts both bootstrap-failure-leaves-phase-unchanged and the recovery re-bootstrap.

entries.desc: The injected bootstrap-failure path does not require a real failing git operation (uses an injectable seam) yet still exercises the cli-engine ordering

evidence.note: The injected bootstrap failure is deterministic (an unfrozen INIT story tripping the scope-anti-expansion freeze gate), requiring no flaky real git failure, yet still exercising the cli-engine INIT_CHECK ordering.

entries.desc: Test guards against regression: if phase were advanced before bootstrap, the partial-advance assertion fails loudly

evidence.note: The load-bearing assertion after.index.phase===INIT fails loudly if anyone reverts to advancing the phase before bootstrap, guarding against partial-advance regression.
